title: Help after a try, cues first
statement: Offer help only after the student has tried, and order hints from general cues to specific ones, naming the clue's own words only in the last hint.
detail: A course feedback meeting warned that an immediately available hint lowers desirable difficulty and set the rule: attempt first, then targeted help. A census of the lessons flagged guided-practice nudges that named the clue's own words instead of a criterion cue, and the fix pattern rewords them as criterion cues, naming the clue's actual words only in the last nudge. The general cues say what to look for.
against: When help should start was never settled: three consecutive errors was offered as a trigger, but neither the exact count nor an exception policy was finalized (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0172-g3-reading-course-feedback-2026-08-04.qmd`, line 43). It is a fix pattern from a census, not yet a hard validator.
